function.name: COMCAT_RegisterClassCategories
function.description: This function registers class categories in the system registry.

parameters.name: rclsid
parameters.description: The CLSID that identifies the COM class object

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: The type of the class category

parameters.name: cCategories
parameters.description: The number of category identifiers in the array rgcatid

parameters.name: rgcatid
parameters.description: Pointer to an array of category identifiers

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the success or failure of the function. Returns S_OK if successful, E_FAIL if failed, or E_POINTER if rgcatid is NULL and cCategories is not zero.

function.name: COMCAT_UnRegisterClassCategories
function.description: This function unregisters class categories. It formats the class category type key name, opens the class category type key, formats the category key name and unregisters it.

parameters.name: rclsid
parameters.description: This is the class identifier.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: This is the type of the class.

parameters.name: cCategories
parameters.description: This is the count of categories.

parameters.name: rgcatid
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the category identifier.

function.return_type: HRESULT, it represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, E_POINTER if the pointer is null, E_FAIL if the operation fails, or the error code if the operation fails.

function.name: COMCAT_GetCategoryDesc
function.description: This function retrieves the description of a category from the registry using the given key and locale ID (lcid). The description is stored in the provided buffer (pszDesc) up to the specified number of wide characters (buf_wchars).

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Handle to an open registry key.

parameters.name: lcid
parameters.description: Locale identifier for the description to be retrieved.

parameters.name: pszDesc
parameters.description: Pointer to a buffer that receives the category description.

parameters.name: buf_wchars
parameters.description: Size of the pszDesc buffer in wide characters.

function.return_type: HRESULT, where S_OK represents success, E_INVALIDARG indicates an invalid argument was passed, and CAT_E_NODESCRIPTION indicates that the category has no description.

function.name: COMCAT_PrepareClassCategories
function.description: This function prepares class categories by allocating memory for them, setting their size and offsets, and populating them with strings from GUIDs.

parameters.name: impl_count
parameters.description: The count of implemented categories.

parameters.name: impl_catids
parameters.description: Pointer to the implemented category IDs.

parameters.name: req_count
parameters.description: The count of required categories.

parameters.name: req_catids
parameters.description: Pointer to the required category IDs.

function.return_type: struct class_categories*. It represents a pointer to the prepared class categories.

function.name: COMCAT_IsClassOfCategories
function.description: This function checks if a given class implements all the given categories and if all categories required by the class are given. It opens the classes key for each category and checks if it exists. If not, it returns S_FALSE. It also checks if all required categories are given, if not, it returns S_FALSE. If all checks pass, it returns S_OK.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: This is a handle to an open registry key. This handle is used to read from the registry.

parameters.name: categories
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a structure that contains information about the categories to be checked. It contains offsets to the implemented and required categories.

function.return_type: HRESULT. It returns S_OK if all checks pass, otherwise it returns S_FALSE.

function.name: COMCAT_ICatRegister_QueryInterface
function.description: This function queries an interface and returns a pointer to that interface if it is supported.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface being queried.

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface being queried.

parameters.name: ppvObj
parameters.description: Address of the pointer that receives the interface pointer requested in riid.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the call. Returns S_OK if the interface is supported, E_NOINTERFACE if not, and E_POINTER if ppvObj is NULL.

function.name: COMCAT_ICatRegister_AddRef
function.description: This function is a non-heap based object that returns a static value of 2.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is an interface used in the function.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents a static value of 2

function.name: COMCAT_ICatRegister_Release
function.description: This function is a static method that returns a ULONG value. It is non-heap based.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is an interface used in the function.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents a non-heap based object.

function.name: COMCAT_ICatRegister_RegisterCategories
function.description: This function registers categories in the component category manager. It creates or opens the component categories key and the key for each category, then sets the value for each locale's description.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface for the category register

parameters.name: cCategories
parameters.description: Number of categories to register

parameters.name: rgci
parameters.description: Pointer to an array of CATEGORYINFO structures that provide information about the categories to register

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the success or failure of the function. Returns S_OK if successful, E_POINTER if the rgci parameter is NULL and cCategories is not zero, and E_FAIL if the function fails to create or open the component categories key.

function.name: COMCAT_ICatRegister_UnRegisterCategories
function.description: This function unregisters categories in the component category manager. It opens the component categories key, then iterates over the categories to unregister, deleting the key for each category.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface for the category register

parameters.name: cCategories
parameters.description: Number of categories to unregister

parameters.name: rgcatid
parameters.description: Array of category IDs to unregister

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if successful, E_POINTER if the rgcatid is NULL and cCategories is not 0, and E_FAIL if opening the component categories key fails

function.name: COMCAT_ICatRegister_RegisterClassImplCategories
function.description: This function is used to register class implementation categories.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface for the category register

parameters.name: rclsid
parameters.description: Reference to the class ID

parameters.name: cCategories
parameters.description: Number of categories

parameters.name: rgcatid
parameters.description: Pointer to the category ID

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation, success or the error code

function.name: COMCAT_ICatRegister_UnRegisterClassImplCategories
function.description: This function unregisters the categories implemented by a class.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an interface

parameters.name: rclsid
parameters.description: Reference to the class identifier

parameters.name: cCategories
parameters.description: Number of categories

parameters.name: rgcatid
parameters.description: Pointer to the array of category identifiers

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation, success or an error code

function.name: COMCAT_ICatRegister_RegisterClassReqCategories
function.description: This function is used to register required categories for a class.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface for category registration

parameters.name: rclsid
parameters.description: Class identifier to register categories for

parameters.name: cCategories
parameters.description: Number of categories to register

parameters.name: rgcatid
parameters.description: Array of category identifiers to register

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If it fails, it returns an error code.

function.name: COMCAT_ICatRegister_UnRegisterClassReqCategories
function.description: This function unregisters the required categories for a class.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface pointer

parameters.name: rclsid
parameters.description: Class ID reference

parameters.name: cCategories
parameters.description: Number of categories

parameters.name: rgcatid
parameters.description: Pointer to an array of category IDs

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation

function.name: COMCAT_ICatInformation_QueryInterface
function.description: This function is used to query an interface in the COMCAT component.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an interface.

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface being requested.

parameters.name: ppvObj
parameters.description: Address of pointer variable that receives the interface pointer requested in riid.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the call to the function. It can provide detailed error information if the function fails.

function.name: COMCAT_ICatInformation_AddRef
function.description: This function is used to increase the reference count of the COMCAT_ComCatMgr.ICatRegister_iface object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is an interface pointer to the ICatInformation object.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count of the COMCAT_ComCatMgr.ICatRegister_iface object.

function.name: COMCAT_ICatInformation_Release
function.description: This function releases the ICatRegister interface of the COMCAT_ComCatMgr object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is a pointer to the ICatInformation interface.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the status of the release operation.

function.name: COMCAT_ICatInformation_EnumCategories
function.description: This function checks if the ppenumCatInfo parameter is NULL, and if not, it calls the EnumCATEGORYINFO_Construct function with the provided parameters.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface for the category information

parameters.name: lcid
parameters.description: Locale identifier

parameters.name: ppenumCatInfo
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to an IEnumCATEGORYINFO interface

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the function call. If ppenumCatInfo is NULL, it returns E_POINTER. Otherwise, it returns the result of the EnumCATEGORYINFO_Construct function call.

function.name: COMCAT_ICatInformation_GetCategoryDesc
function.description: This function retrieves the description of a specific category from the component categories. It opens the registry key for the category, allocates memory for the description, retrieves the description and ensures it's null terminated.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an ICatInformation interface

parameters.name: rcatid
parameters.description: Reference to the category identifier

parameters.name: lcid
parameters.description: Locale identifier for the description

parameters.name: ppszDesc
parameters.description: Pointer to a buffer that receives the category description

function.return_type: HRESULT. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If the function fails, it may return E_INVALIDARG, E_FAIL, CAT_E_CATIDNOEXIST, or E_OUTOFMEMORY.

function.name: COMCAT_ICatInformation_EnumClassesOfCategories
function.description: This function enumerates the classes of categories in COMCAT. It prepares class categories, constructs a CLSID enumeration, and handles errors.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface for the category information

parameters.name: cImplemented
parameters.description: Number of implemented categories

parameters.name: rgcatidImpl
parameters.description: Array of implemented category IDs

parameters.name: cRequired
parameters.description: Number of required categories

parameters.name: rgcatidReq
parameters.description: Array of required category IDs

parameters.name: ppenumCLSID
parameters.description: Pointer to the enumeration of CLSID

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the function execution. It returns E_POINTER if the input parameters are invalid, E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation fails, or the status of the CLSID enumeration construction.

function.name: COMCAT_ICatInformation_IsClassOfCategories
function.description: This function checks if a class is part of certain categories. It performs this by preparing the class categories, opening the classes key, and then checking if the class is part of the categories. If any of these operations fail, it returns an error code.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an interface

parameters.name: rclsid
parameters.description: Class identifier

parameters.name: cImplemented
parameters.description: Number of implemented categories

parameters.name: rgcatidImpl
parameters.description: Array of implemented category identifiers

parameters.name: cRequired
parameters.description: Number of required categories

parameters.name: rgcatidReq
parameters.description: Array of required category identifiers

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It could be a success code, an error code or a warning code.

function.name: COMCAT_ICatInformation_EnumImplCategoriesOfClass
function.description: This function enumerates the implemented categories of a class.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an interface

parameters.name: rclsid
parameters.description: Reference to the class ID

parameters.name: ppenumCATID
parameters.description: Pointer to an enumerator for category IDs

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation, returns E_POINTER if rclsid or ppenumCATID is NULL

function.name: COMCAT_ICatInformation_EnumReqCategoriesOfClass
function.description: This function enumerates the required categories of a class.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface for the category information.

parameters.name: rclsid
parameters.description: Reference to the class ID.

parameters.name: ppenumCATID
parameters.description: Pointer to the enumerator for the category ID.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns E_POINTER if rclsid or ppenumCATID is NULL.

function.name: ComCat_CreateInstance
function.description: This function creates an instance of the component category manager. It does not support aggregation and returns an error if the object pointer is null or if the requested interface is not available.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the class factory interface

parameters.name: pUnkOuter
parameters.description: Pointer to the controlling IUnknown interface of the aggregate

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface being requested

parameters.name: ppvObj
parameters.description: Address of pointer variable that receives the interface pointer requested in riid

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It can return E_POINTER if ppvObj is NULL, CLASS_E_NOAGGREGATION if pUnkOuter is not NULL, or CLASS_E_CLASSNOTAVAILABLE if the requested interface is not available.

function.name: impl_from_IEnumCATEGORYINFO
function.description: This function returns a pointer to an instance of IEnumCATEGORYINFOImpl that contains the given IEnumCATEGORYINFO interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IEnumCATEGORYINFO interface

function.return_type: IEnumCATEGORYINFOImpl* - Pointer to an instance of IEnumCATEGORYINFOImpl that contains the given IEnumCATEGORYINFO interface

function.name: COMCAT_IEnumCATEGORYINFO_AddRef
function.description: This function increments the reference count of the IEnumCATEGORYINFO interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IEnumCATEGORYINFO interface whose reference count is to be incremented.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count after increment.

function.name: COMCAT_IEnumCATEGORYINFO_QueryInterface
function.description: This function checks if the provided interface supports the requested interface ID (IID). If it does, it increments the reference count and returns a pointer to that interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface being queried.

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Identifier of the interface being requested.

parameters.name: ppvObj
parameters.description: If successful, receives a pointer to the requested interface.

function.return_type: HRESULT, where S_OK represents success, E_NOINTERFACE represents that the requested interface is not supported, and E_POINTER represents that ppvObj is NULL.

function.name: COMCAT_IEnumCATEGORYINFO_Release
function.description: This function releases the IEnumCATEGORYINFO interface and decrements the reference count. If the reference count is 0, it closes the registry key and frees the memory allocated to the interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IEnumCATEGORYINFO interface to be released

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count after the release operation

function.name: COMCAT_IEnumCATEGORYINFO_Next
function.description: This function is used to fetch the next set of CATEGORYINFO from the enumeration. It will fetch as many elements as specified by 'celt', or until it reaches the end of the enumeration.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface of the enumeration object.

parameters.name: celt
parameters.description: The number of CATEGORYINFO elements to fetch.

parameters.name: rgelt
parameters.description: Pointer to the location where the fetched CATEGORYINFO elements will be stored.

parameters.name: pceltFetched
parameters.description: Pointer to a location where the function will store the actual number of elements fetched. This can be less than 'celt' if the end of the enumeration is reached.

function.return_type: HRESULT, where the return value is S_OK if the exact number of requested elements have been fetched, S_FALSE if fewer elements have been fetched, and E_POINTER if the 'rgelt' parameter is NULL.

function.name: COMCAT_IEnumCATEGORYINFO_Skip
function.description: This function skips a certain number of elements in the IEnumCATEGORYINFO interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IEnumCATEGORYINFO interface where elements are to be skipped.

parameters.name: celt
parameters.description: The number of elements to skip in the interface.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if the operation is successful, and S_FALSE if there aren't enough elements to skip.

function.name: COMCAT_IEnumCATEGORYINFO_Reset
function.description: This function resets the enumeration sequence to the beginning.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an interface for enumeration of category information.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. S_OK indicates success.

function.name: COMCAT_IEnumCATEGORYINFO_Clone
function.description: This function clones an instance of IEnumCATEGORYINFO interface and assigns it to the provided pointer.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IEnumCATEGORYINFO interface to be cloned.

parameters.name: ppenum
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer, where the cloned IEnumCATEGORYINFO interface will be assigned.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, E_POINTER if the ppenum is NULL, and E_OUTOFMEMORY if the memory allocation for the new object fails.

function.name: EnumCATEGORYINFO_Construct
function.description: This function allocates memory for an IEnumCATEGORYINFOImpl object, initializes it, and returns a pointer to its IEnumCATEGORYINFO interface.

parameters.name: lcid
parameters.description: This parameter is used to specify the locale identifier.

parameters.name: ret
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a pointer to an IEnumCATEGORYINFO interface. The function sets this pointer to point to the IEnumCATEGORYINFO interface of the newly created object.

function.return_type: HRESULT. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If it fails to allocate memory, it returns E_OUTOFMEMORY.

function.name: impl_from_IEnumCLSID
function.description: This function returns the containing record for the given interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Interface from which to get the containing record

function.return_type: CLSID_IEnumGUIDImpl*, represents the containing record for the given interface

function.name: CLSIDEnumGUID_QueryInterface
function.description: This function queries an interface and returns a pointer to that interface if it is supported.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface being queried.

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface being queried.

parameters.name: ppvObj
parameters.description: Pointer to the location that receives the interface pointer requested in riid.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the call. Returns S_OK if the interface is supported, E_NOINTERFACE if not, and E_POINTER if ppvObj is NULL.

function.name: CLSIDEnumGUID_AddRef
function.description: This function increments the reference count of the IEnumGUID interface object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IEnumGUID interface object whose reference count is to be incremented.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count after increment.

function.name: CLSIDEnumGUID_Release
function.description: This function releases the interface of the GUID enumerator and frees up the memory used by it. It also closes the registry key if it is open.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is a pointer to the interface of the GUID enumerator.

function.return_type: ULONG. This function returns the new reference count. If the reference count is zero, it means that the object is freed.

function.name: CLSIDEnumGUID_Next
function.description: This function enumerates through GUIDs in the registry. It retrieves a specified number of items in the enumeration sequence. If there are fewer than the requested number of elements left in the sequence, it retrieves the remaining elements.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an interface that allows a client to enumerate through a collection of GUIDs.

parameters.name: celt
parameters.description: The number of elements in the enumeration sequence to retrieve.

parameters.name: rgelt
parameters.description: Pointer to an array to receive the enumerated interfaces.

parameters.name: pceltFetched
parameters.description: Pointer to a location that receives the actual number of elements enumerated.

function.return_type: HRESULT. If the method is successful, the return value is S_OK. If the end of the enumeration sequence has been reached, the return value is S_FALSE. If the rgelt parameter is NULL, the return value is E_POINTER.

function.name: CLSIDEnumGUID_Skip
function.description: This function is used to skip a specified number of elements in the enumeration sequence.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an interface that allows a client to enumerate through a collection of GUIDs.

parameters.name: celt
parameters.description: The number of elements to be skipped in the enumeration sequence.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the result of the operation. Returns S_OK if the operation was successful.

function.name: CLSIDEnumGUID_Reset
function.description: This function resets the enumeration sequence to the beginning.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an enumeration interface

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the result of the operation. S_OK indicates success.

function.name: CLSIDEnumGUID_Clone
function.description: This function clones an IEnumGUID interface and allocates memory for the new clone. It also opens a registry key for the clone and sets its next index to the same as the original.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the original IEnumGUID interface to be cloned.

parameters.name: ppenum
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer, where the address of the cloned IEnumGUID interface will be stored.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, E_POINTER if the ppenum parameter is NULL, or E_OUTOFMEMORY if the function fails to allocate memory for the clone.

function.name: CLSIDEnumGUID_Construct
function.description: This function allocates memory for a new CLSID_IEnumGUIDImpl object, initializes it, and opens the registry key for the class identifier (CLSID).

parameters.name: categories
parameters.description: Pointer to a structure that contains class categories.

parameters.name: ret
parameters.description: Double pointer to an IEnumCLSID interface. This function will set it to point to the IEnumGUID_iface interface of the newly created CLSID_IEnumGUIDImpl object.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which is a data type used in Windows programming to represent error conditions, and warning, informational, or success messages. The function returns S_OK on success, or an error code like E_OUTOFMEMORY on failure.

function.name: impl_from_IEnumCATID
function.description: This function returns the containing record for the given interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IEnumGUID interface

function.return_type: CATID_IEnumGUIDImpl pointer, representing the containing record for the given interface

function.name: CATIDEnumGUID_QueryInterface
function.description: This function checks if the provided interface supports the requested interface ID (IID). If it does, it returns a pointer to that interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface to be queried.

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface being requested.

parameters.name: ppvObj
parameters.description: Pointer to the memory location that receives the interface pointer requested in riid. Upon successful return, *ppvObj contains the requested interface pointer. If the object does not support the interface, *ppvObj is NULL.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the interface is supported, E_NOINTERFACE if not, and E_POINTER if ppvObj is NULL.

function.name: CATIDEnumGUID_AddRef
function.description: This function increments the reference count of the IEnumGUID interface object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IEnumGUID interface object whose reference count is to be incremented.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count after increment.

function.name: CATIDEnumGUID_Release
function.description: This function releases the IEnumGUID interface and decrements the reference count. If the reference count becomes zero, it closes the registry key and frees the memory allocated to the interface.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IEnumGUID interface that is to be released

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count after the decrement. If the count is zero, it indicates that the interface has been released.

function.name: CATIDEnumGUID_Next
function.description: This function enumerates through the GUIDs in a registry key. It fetches a specified number of GUIDs and returns the number of GUIDs actually fetched.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an interface that allows a client to enumerate through an array of GUIDs.

parameters.name: celt
parameters.description: The number of GUIDs to fetch from the registry key.

parameters.name: rgelt
parameters.description: Pointer to the location where the fetched GUIDs are returned.

parameters.name: pceltFetched
parameters.description: Pointer to the location where the number of GUIDs actually fetched is returned.

function.return_type: HRESULT. If the function successfully fetches the specified number of GUIDs, it returns S_OK. If it fetches fewer GUIDs than requested, it returns S_FALSE. If the rgelt parameter is NULL, it returns E_POINTER.

function.name: CATIDEnumGUID_Skip
function.description: This function skips a specified number of elements in the enumeration sequence.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an interface that allows a client to enumerate through a collection of GUIDs.

parameters.name: celt
parameters.description: The count of elements to be skipped in the enumeration sequence.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the result of the operation. Returns S_OK if successful.

function.name: CATIDEnumGUID_Reset
function.description: This function resets the index of the enumeration to 0.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an interface used to enumerate the GUIDs.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. S_OK indicates success.

function.name: CATIDEnumGUID_Clone
function.description: This function clones an IEnumGUID interface, allocating a new memory block for the clone and copying the original data into it.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the original IEnumGUID interface to be cloned

parameters.name: ppenum
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer, which will point to the cloned IEnumGUID interface after the function execution

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation was successful, E_POINTER if the ppenum parameter is NULL, and E_OUTOFMEMORY if the memory allocation for the new clone failed

function.name: CATIDEnumGUID_Construct
function.description: This function constructs an enumeration of GUIDs for a given class ID and postfix. It allocates memory for the enumeration, generates a key name from the class ID and postfix, opens the corresponding registry key, and returns the enumeration.

parameters.name: rclsid
parameters.description: The class ID to enumerate GUIDs for.

parameters.name: postfix
parameters.description: The postfix to append to the class ID when generating the key name.

parameters.name: ret
parameters.description: A pointer to a pointer to an IEnumGUID interface. This function sets *ret to the constructed enumeration.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the function succeeds, or an error code if the function fails.
